Luke will drive in FP1 in Brazil and Mexico ✅
Our reserve driver is set to complete the team's final two mandated rookie FP1 sessions, driving Alex Albon’s FW48 in Mexico and Carlos Sainz’s car in Brazil. Tap the link here to find out more: https://bit.ly/4ik8grH 🔗
